title: MORCA: Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Cache Reuse in Video Diffusion Acceleration
title_zh: MORCA：面向视频扩散加速的自适应缓存重用离线转在线强化学习

paragraphs.en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) achieve remarkable performance in video synthesis, but their iterative denoising process suffers from high inference latency. To address this, caching has emerged as an effective acceleration strategy by capitalizing on inter-step redundancy during denoising. Existing dynamic caching methods typically estimate the error that cache reuse would introduce at each denoising step (step error) to guide cache decisions, whereas our concern is how much quality loss cache reuse would cause in the final generated video (terminal error). We show that step error does not directly correspond to terminal error and that latent information helps capture their relationship, thereby informing cache decisions. Moreover, existing threshold-based methods cannot provide precise speedup control, making it difficult to meet practical requirements for user-specified acceleration targets. To address these limitations, we introduce MORCA , a cache scheduling framework trained through offline-to-online reinforcement learning to make latent-aware reuse/recompute decisions under user-specified acceleration targets. Extensive experiments on different video generation models across multiple target acceleration ratios demonstrate that MORCA achieves better generation fidelity than state-of-the-art caching methods under comparable computational budgets. Code is available at https://github.com/x10ngyx/MORCA .
paragraphs.zh: 扩散变换器（DiTs）在视频合成方面取得了显著成效，但其迭代去噪过程存在较高的推理延迟问题。 为了解决这一问题，缓存技术已成为一种有效的加速策略，它利用了去噪过程中各步骤之间的冗余信息。 现有的动态缓存方法通常通过估算每次去噪步骤中重复使用缓存可能引入的误差（步骤误差）来指导缓存决策，而我们的关注点则是重复使用缓存最终会导致生成视频产生多大的质量损失（终端误差）。 我们发现，步骤误差并不直接对应于终端误差，而潜在信息有助于捕捉二者之间的关系，从而为缓存决策提供依据。 此外，现有的基于阈值的方法无法实现精确的加速控制，使得满足用户指定的加速目标这一实际需求变得困难。 为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了 MORCA——一个通过离线到在线强化学习进行训练的缓存调度框架，能够在用户指定的加速目标下，基于潜在信息做出重复使用或重新计算的决策。 在多种视频生成模型上针对多个目标加速比进行的广泛实验表明，在计算资源相当的情况下，MORCA 相比当前最先进的缓存方法能够生成更高保真度的视频。 代码可在 https://github.com/x10ngyx/MORCA 获取。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) combined with Flow Matching paradigms ( Lipman et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023 ) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in high-fidelity visual generation ( Wan et al., 2025 ; Kong et al., 2025 ) . Despite this progress, the multi-step iterative denoising process incurs substantial computational cost and high inference latency, particularly for video synthesis. To address this bottleneck, various acceleration approaches have emerged, including distillation, quantization, sparse attention, and caching. Among these, distillation requires additional training of the generative model, while quantization and sparse attention typically rely on specialized kernels. Caching offers a lightweight alternative with flexible speed–quality trade-offs.

paragraphs.en: Cache-based methods exploit inter-step redundancy by skipping the computation of the entire denoising network or selected components (typically the DiT blocks) at some denoising steps and reusing the corresponding results cached at previous steps. Early methods adopt fixed cache schedules ( Ma et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2025b ; Liu et al., 2025b ) (e.g., recomputing only at fixed intervals), which do not account for runtime denoising dynamics. Dynamic caching methods ( Liu et al., 2025a ; Kahatapitiya et al., 2025 ; Chung et al., 2026 ; Bu et al., 2026 ) attempt to estimate the error that cache reuse would introduce at each denoising step and use these estimates to make cache decisions through threshold-based rules.
paragraphs.zh: 基于缓存的方法通过跳过某些去噪步骤中整个去噪网络或部分组件（通常是 DiT 模块）的计算，并复用先前步骤中缓存的相应结果，从而利用步骤间的冗余性。 早期的方法采用固定的缓存调度策略（Ma et al., 2024；Li et al., 2024；Zhao et al., 2025b；Liu et al., 2025b）（例如，仅在固定时间间隔内重新计算），但并未考虑运行时去噪的动态变化。 动态缓存方法（Liu et al., 2025a；Kahatapitiya et al., 2025；Chung et al., 2026；Bu et al., 2026）试图估算每次去噪步骤中复用缓存可能引入的误差，并利用这些估算值通过基于阈值的规则做出缓存决策。

How the former translates into the latter through subsequent denoising steps remains unclear. To investigate this relationship, we conduct a series of experiments. As shown in Fig. 1 , step error exhibits similar patterns across these prompts, while terminal error varies substantially. Quantitative results in Table 1 further show that step error alone is insufficient to accurately predict terminal error.

paragraphs.en: We propose that latents may contain information that helps capture how step error translates into terminal error, thus informing cache decisions. To test this idea, we train a predictor to estimate terminal error from step error. As reported in Table 1 , incorporating lightweight features extracted from the input latents at the current and previous steps (see Sec. 3.2 ) substantially improves prediction accuracy.

paragraphs.en: Motivated by this finding, we train a latent-aware scheduler to make terminal-error-guided cache decisions. We provide the scheduler with SeaCache’s proxy signal for step error (see Sec. 3.1 ) and latent features to help bridge the gap between step error and terminal error. Given the sequential nature of cache scheduling, we formulate it as a Markov decision process (MDP) and optimize the scheduler using reinforcement learning. In practical applications, users often require a specific acceleration ratio. While existing threshold-based caching methods offer only approximate speedup control through threshold adjustment, we use the observed relationship between speedup and the number of reuse steps (Fig. 3 ) to translate the target acceleration ratio into a reuse budget constraint, then reduce the resulting constrained MDP to an equivalent standard augmented MDP (Sec. 3.2 ).

paragraphs.en: Since collecting training data requires costly inference runs, we adopt an offline-to-online reinforcement learning framework based on IQL ( Kostrikov et al., 2022 ) to train the scheduler. As an off-policy algorithm, IQL offers higher data utilization than on-policy methods. Offline training provides an effective and stable initialization from limited data, while online fine-tuning allows the scheduler to explore under its current policy and further improve performance. Our contributions are summarized as follows:

paragraphs.en: We propose MORCA , a latent-aware cache scheduling framework trained through offline-to-online reinforcement learning to make adaptive cache decisions under user-specified speedups.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 MORCA——一个感知潜在状态的缓存调度框架，该框架通过离线到在线的强化学习进行训练，能够在用户指定的加速需求下做出自适应的缓存决策。

paragraphs.en: We design a budget-constrained and latent-aware scheduler that can make terminal-error-guided cache decisions while precisely controlling the acceleration ratio.
paragraphs.zh: 我们设计了一种受预算限制且能感知潜在状态的调度器，该调度器能够在精确控制加速比的同时，根据终端错误做出缓存决策。

paragraphs.en: We introduce an offline-to-online RL paradigm for scheduler optimization: the offline stage provides an effective initialization, while online fine-tuning further improves its performance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种用于调度器优化的离线到在线强化学习范式：离线阶段提供有效的初始化，而在线微调则能进一步提升其性能。

paragraphs.en: Extensive experiments on different video generation models demonstrate that MORCA achieves better speed–quality trade-offs than state-of-the-art caching methods.
paragraphs.zh: 针对多种视频生成模型进行的广泛实验表明，MORCA 在速度-质量权衡方面优于当前的先进缓存方法。

paragraphs.en: Existing approaches to accelerating diffusion inference mainly include fast sampling, distillation, quantization, sparse attention, and caching. Fast samplers and numerical solvers reduce model evaluations but may sacrifice quality under aggressive step reduction ( Song et al., 2021 ; Liu et al., 2022 ; Lu et al., 2022 ; Lu et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2023 ) . Distillation enables few-step or one-step generation but requires additional training ( Salimans and Ho, 2022 ; Song et al., 2023 ; Luo et al., 2023 ; Yin et al., 2024 ) . Quantization reduces the precision of weights and activations ( Shang et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2023 ; He et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2025a ) , while sparse attention restricts attention computation to selected token pairs ( Xi et al., 2025 ) . Both effectively lower per-step computation but typically rely on specialized kernels to realize inference speedups.

paragraphs.en: Cache-based acceleration methods exploit inter-step redundancy by skipping computation in all or part of the denoising network at selected steps and reusing previously cached results. These methods can be characterized along three complementary dimensions. Caching Granularity determines what is cached and reused, including layer or DiT-block outputs ( Wimbauer et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) , attention outputs ( Zhao et al., 2025b ) , CFG branch outputs ( Lyu et al., 2025 ) , and finer-grained token features ( Zou et al., 2025 ) . Cache Reuse Strategy determines how cached features are utilized, evolving from direct reuse ( Ma et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2025b ) to feature correction or approximation ( Lyu et al., 2025 ; Bu et al., 2026 ) , and further to explicit feature forecasting ( Liu et al., 2025b ) . Caching Schedule determines which steps reuse cached results and which recompute. Early methods typically employ fixed schedules with predefined recomputation steps ( Ma et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2025b ; Liu et al., 2025b ) , which do not adapt to runtime denoising dynamics. Dynamic methods instead estimate the error that cache reuse would introduce at each step and apply threshold-based rules to guide cache decisions. TeaCache uses timestep-modulated input differences as a proxy for output variation, AdaCache further incorporates motion-aware information, DiCache estimates caching errors through shallow-layer probes, and SeaCache derives a spectral-evolution-aware cache signal by suppressing noise-dominated components ( Liu et al., 2025a ; Kahatapitiya et al., 2025 ; Bu et al., 2026 ; Chung et al., 2026 ) . Recent works have also explored learning-based cache scheduling ( Zhao et al., 2026b ; Xie et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026a ) , which we discuss and compare in detail in Sec. 2.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 基于缓存的加速方法通过跳过降噪网络中某些步骤的全部或部分计算，并复用先前缓存的结果，来利用步骤间的冗余性。 这些方法可以从三个互补的维度进行描述。 缓存粒度决定了缓存和复用的内容，包括层或 DiT 模块的输出（Wimbauer 等，2024；Chen 等，2024）、注意力输出（Zhao 等，2025b）、CFG 分支输出（Lyu 等，2025）以及更细粒度的词元特征（Zou 等，2025）。 缓存复用策略决定了缓存特征的使用方式，从直接复用（Ma 等，2024；Zhao 等，2025b）逐步发展为特征修正或近似（Lyu 等，2025；Bu 等，2026），并进一步演变为显式特征预测（Liu 等，2025b）。 缓存调度决定了哪些步骤复用缓存结果，哪些步骤重新计算。 早期的方法通常采用固定调度，包含预定义的重新计算步骤（Ma 等，2024；Li 等，2024；Zhao 等，2025b；Liu 等，2025b），无法适应运行时降噪的动态变化。 动态方法则通过估计每一步因缓存复用可能引入的误差，并应用基于阈值的规则来指导缓存决策。 TeaCache 使用经时间步调节的输入差异作为输出变化的代理指标；AdaCache 进一步融入了运动感知信息；DiCache 通过浅层探针估计缓存误差；SeaCache 则通过抑制噪声主导的成分，推导出感知光谱演变的缓存信号（Liu 等，2025a；Kahatapitiya 等，2025；Bu 等，2026；Chung 等，2026）。 近期的研究还探索了基于学习的缓存调度（Zhao 等，2026b；Xie 等，2026；Zhao 等，2026a），我们将在第 2.3 节中对其进行详细讨论和比较。

paragraphs.en: Cache scheduling is naturally a sequential decision problem suited to reinforcement learning. RAPID 3 is the first work to formulate cache scheduling as an MDP and train a scheduler through reinforcement learning to make cache-reuse decisions at each denoising step ( Zhao et al., 2026b ) . Concurrent with our work, BAG and OnlineCache explore different approaches to learning cache schedules. BAG constructs a high-quality schedule dataset through expensive offline search and distills these schedules into a lightweight gating network for per-step decisions ( Zhao et al., 2026a ) . OnlineCache uses REINFORCE to train a latent-aware scheduler, but its on-policy RL paradigm limits data reuse and training flexibility. Moreover, its reward-based speedup control cannot guarantee meeting user-specified acceleration targets ( Xie et al., 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: In this section, we present MORCA, an offline-to-online reinforcement learning framework for budget-constrained and latent-aware cache scheduling in video diffusion acceleration, as illustrated in Fig. 2 . Building upon SeaCache (Sec. 3.1 ), MORCA retains its caching granularity and cache reuse strategy while replacing its threshold-based decision rule with a learned scheduler. In addition to SeaCache’s signals and related statistics, the scheduler incorporates latent features and reuse budget dynamics to make terminal-error-guided cache decisions under user-specified acceleration targets (Sec. 3.2 ). We optimize the scheduler through a two-stage offline-to-online IQL paradigm to achieve both high sample efficiency and strong performance (Sec. 3.3 ).

paragraphs.en: Since collecting cache-scheduling trajectories requires expensive video-generation rollouts, we adopt a two-stage offline-to-online reinforcement learning paradigm based on Implicit Q-Learning (IQL) ( Kostrikov et al., 2022 ) to achieve both high sample efficiency and strong performance. As an off-policy algorithm, IQL enables repeated reuse of collected data across optimization updates, unlike on-policy methods such as REINFORCE, which require fresh rollouts under the current policy. In the offline stage, the scheduler learns from a relatively small set of pre-collected random trajectories, providing an effective policy initialization. Starting from this initialization, online fine-tuning enables further exploration and policy improvement.
paragraphs.zh: 由于收集缓存调度轨迹需要耗费大量资源进行视频生成模拟，我们采用了一种基于隐式 Q 学习（IQL）（Kostrikov 等人，2022）的两阶段离线到在线强化学习范式，以实现高样本效率和强大性能。 作为一种离策略算法，IQL 使得收集到的数据可以在多次优化更新中重复使用，这与 REINFORCE 等在策略方法不同，后者需要在当前策略下生成新的模拟数据。 在离线阶段，调度器从一组相对较小的预收集随机轨迹中学习，从而为策略提供有效的初始化。 基于这一初始化，在线微调能够进一步促进探索并改进策略。

paragraphs.en: By learning preferentially from higher-advantage actions in a relatively small dataset of randomly sampled trajectories, the offline stage provides a good initial policy without requiring prior knowledge of effective cache schedules. In contrast, starting online training from scratch may incur substantial unnecessary data collection and training costs under an initially weak policy.
paragraphs.zh: 通过在随机采样的轨迹构成的相对较小的数据集中优先学习优势更高的动作，离线阶段无需事先了解有效的缓存调度策略，即可提供一个良好的初始策略。 相比之下，如果从初始较弱的策略开始在线训练，则可能会产生大量不必要的数据收集与训练成本。

paragraphs.en: Starting from the offline-trained scheduler, we perform online fine-tuning as shown in Algorithm 1 (b). In each round, we collect a batch of online trajectories under randomly sampled prompts and target acceleration ratios, sampling each step’s cache decision from the current scheduler policy π φ ( ⋅ ∣ z t ) \pi_{\varphi}(\cdot\mid z_{t}) . These trajectories are added to the replay buffer alongside the offline and previously collected online data. We first perform a short critic-only warm-up with the policy fixed to adapt the Q- and V-networks to the new data, then jointly train the value functions and policy using the same IQL procedure as in offline training. Sampling trajectories from the current policy enables further exploration, while retaining the offline data in the replay buffer helps stabilize learning during fine-tuning.

paragraphs.en: We presented MORCA, a cache scheduling framework for accelerating video diffusion models. Motivated by the gap between step error and terminal error that existing methods do not adequately address, along with their limited control over acceleration ratios, we formulated cache scheduling as an MDP, designed a budget-constrained and latent-aware scheduler for terminal-error-guided decisions under user-specified acceleration targets, and optimized it through offline-to-online IQL training. Extensive experiments on different video generation models demonstrate that MORCA achieves better speed–quality trade-offs than state-of-the-art caching methods. As a schedule-level approach, MORCA can potentially be combined with different caching granularities and cache reuse strategies for further gains. Exploring these combinations is a promising direction for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 MORCA，一个用于加速视频扩散模型的缓存调度框架。 鉴于现有方法未能充分解决步错误与终端错误之间的差距，且对加速比的控制有限，我们将缓存调度建模为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），设计了一种受预算限制且感知潜变量的调度器，以在用户指定的加速目标下实现由终端错误引导的决策，并通过离线到在线的 IQL 训练对其进行优化。 在不同视频生成模型上进行的广泛实验表明，MORCA 在速度-质量权衡方面优于当前的先进缓存方法。 作为一种调度层级的方法，MORCA 有望与不同的缓存粒度及缓存重用策略相结合，以进一步提升性能。 探索这些组合是未来工作的一个有前景的方向。

paragraphs.en: A straightforward way to generate random cache schedules is to independently sample a reuse/recompute decision at each denoising step. However, this is likely to produce trajectories with limited learning value, wasting costly generation rollouts. Instead, we adopt a more stable approach by randomizing at the threshold level: we sample a smooth threshold curve that varies across the N N denoising steps, replace SeaCache’s fixed threshold with this curve, and run inference to collect the resulting denoising trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 生成随机缓存调度的一个直接方法是在每个去噪步骤中独立地采样一次重用/重新计算决策。 然而，这种方法很可能产生学习价值有限的轨迹，从而浪费昂贵的生成过程。 相反，我们采用一种更稳定的方法：在阈值层面进行随机化。我们采样一条在整个 N 个去噪步骤中变化的平滑阈值曲线，用这条曲线替换 SeaCache 的固定阈值，然后运行推理以收集由此产生的去噪轨迹。

paragraphs.en: To generate a random threshold curve, we control three aspects: its mean level, amplitude, and shape. The mean level is determined by mapping a sampled target acceleration ratio ρ ⋆ {\rho^{\star}} to a threshold center μ = g ⁡ ( ρ ⋆ ) \mu=g({\rho^{\star}}) through calibration. A randomly sampled amplitude factor determines the magnitude of threshold variations. To generate the shape, we randomly select a few reference steps from the N N denoising steps, sample random relative threshold values at these steps, and apply cubic smoothstep interpolation across all steps. These three factors jointly determine the threshold curve, followed by adjustments to satisfy the required bounds and smoothness constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 为了生成一条随机阈值曲线，我们需要控制三个方面：其平均水平、振幅和形状。 通过校准，将采样得到的目标加速度比 ρ ⋆ {\rho^{\star}} 映射到阈值中心 μ = g ⁡ ( ρ ⋆ ) \mu=g({\rho^{\star}})，从而确定平均水平。 一个随机采样的振幅因子决定了阈值变化的幅度。 为了生成形状，我们从 N 个去噪步骤中随机选择几个参考步骤，在这些步骤上采样随机的相对阈值值，并在所有步骤上应用三次平滑步插值。 这三个因素共同决定了阈值曲线，随后进行调节以满足所需的边界和光滑性约束。

paragraphs.en: We identify two types of forced actions: (1) actions imposed by the exact reuse-budget constraint, when only one action remains feasible; and (2) mandatory recomputation at the first denoising step and the last denoising step, as well as the high-noise/low-noise expert-switching step in Wan2.2. Since these actions are determined by action restrictions rather than policy choices, we exclude the corresponding transitions from the policy loss while retaining them for the standard Q- and V-function updates.
paragraphs.zh: 我们识别出两种强制动作：（1）由精确的重用预算约束所施加的动作，此时仅有一个动作仍可行；以及（2）在 Wan2.2 中，于第一步和最后一步去噪时的强制重新计算，以及在高噪声/低噪声专家切换步骤中的强制操作。 由于这些动作是由动作限制而非策略选择所决定的，因此我们在计算策略损失时排除相应的转移，但保留它们用于标准的 Q 函数和 V 函数更新。

paragraphs.en: Due to differences in denoising dynamics across models, MORCA’s learned scheduler cannot be directly transferred between models and requires separate training for each model. This introduces additional costs for collecting cache-scheduling trajectories and optimizing the scheduler. These costs may limit its practical adoption when training resources are constrained.
paragraphs.zh: 由于不同模型在去噪动态方面存在差异，MORCA 所学习的调度器无法在不同模型之间直接迁移，因此需要为每个模型单独进行训练。 这会增加收集缓存调度轨迹和优化调度器的额外成本。 当训练资源有限时，这些成本可能会限制其实际采用。
